detail.title: Mock: {name}
detail.regenerateBody: The current address stops working immediately; you will need to update the address in apps that use this mock. Use this if the address ended up in the wrong hands.
detail.deleteBody: “{name}” and its call log will be deleted; the address will start returning 404. The collection and examples are not affected.

routes.empty: The “{collection}” collection has no example responses yet. Send a request and choose “Save as example” in the response panel; the mock starts serving that response right away.

calls.empty: No calls yet. Requests to the mock appear here within a few seconds.
calls.summary: Last {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}}; the newest 500 records are kept per mock.

usage.intro: In your app, replace the API's base URL with the mock address. The host in the examples' URLs (or {baseUrl}) is ignored; the best-matching example is returned based on path, method, query and body. Segments like :id match any value.
usage.private: This mock is private: send an API key belonging to a member of this workspace in the x-api-key header (Account menu › Account settings › API keys).
usage.pickIntro: If a path has several examples (e.g. 200 and 404), you can send these headers with the request:
usage.byCode: x-mock-response-code: 404: the example with this status code
usage.byName: x-mock-response-name: Not found: the example with this name
usage.byBody: x-mock-match-request-body: true: only an example with the same body (whitespace and field order are ignored in JSON)
usage.byHeaders: x-mock-match-request-headers: x-tenant,accept: an example with the same values for these headers
usage.fallback: If nothing is specified, the example matching the most segments is chosen, preferring a 2xx response on ties. If nothing matches, 404 mockRequestNotFoundError is returned; you can see the reason in the Calls tab.

settings.intro: A mock serves the example responses saved on the requests in a collection like a real API. Incoming requests are matched to the best-fitting example by method, path, query and body.
settings.name: Name
settings.environmentHint: {token} placeholders in the examples are resolved from here. Values marked secret are never written to the response.
settings.delayError: Enter a whole number between 0 and 60000.
settings.delayHint: Waits before every response, to try out a slow network.
settings.privateHint: Callers must send an API key belonging to a member of this workspace in the x-api-key header. If off, anyone who knows the address can call it.
settings.enabledHint: A disabled mock returns 404 for every request.

panel.title: Mocks
panel.empty: A stand-in server for an API that isn't written yet. It serves the collection's example responses at an address, so the frontend team can build without waiting.
